Rosetta Strato Charity Campaign

About This Video

Design & Data GmbH has partnered with Universe Awareness (UNAWE) to help train teachers and send them one of these lovely toys for use in the classroom. With your pledge we will send a toy to where it's needed most: underprivileged schools around the world. We hope we can count on your support! Your pledge can enter you into a raffle to win the unique Rosetta Strato toy that ventured to the stratosphere.

Summary

We want to help continue Rosetta's legacy, by sharing her heroic story, using the plush toy as an interactive teaching resource to educate school children around the world in astronomy and space sciences.
